snippet.title: Mariachi Legends - Release Date Announce Trailer | Gamescom Opening Night Live
snippet.description:
The wait finally has an end date. Step into the boots of Detective Pablo Cruz and descend into the vibrant, dangerous underworld of Santa Mascota. Master lightning-fast combat, uncover mysteries steeped in rich Mexican folklore, and conquer the shadows when the legend arrives.

👇 Support the game & join the community:
